digest.component_or_area: code review criteria routing and threshold calibration
propositions: Two model-emitted criteria synonyms (sec→security, documentation→docs) are absent from the packaged routing index and incorrectly fall to the default 0.95 posture instead of their criterion's tuned threshold.
The normalization must preserve open-dimension vocabulary design and never close the criteria schema to a fixed enum, since project-supplied criteria in the effective vocabulary are first-class.

The calibration document embeds five load-bearing errors: mischaracterizing sec/documentation as non-LLM-tunable, computing security/docs rows on truncated samples invalidated by normalization, proposing project.review-phase-boundaries at LOW-DATA without reading the overlay, mis-characterizing the data-hygiene label list, and failing to note the calibration script reads no routing index.

Synonym normalization must occur before threshold lookup and nit-suppression in code_review_decide, using effective_criteria (project overlay included) to resolve known-id membership, not the packaged index.
